classification: Logical model only; physical qualifier/reset assertion, timing and fault-containment NOT_PROVEN
scenario_checks: fresh ARM edge consumes qualified LOW and preserves new RUN grant
held HIGH resets timer but does not erase RUN grant
RUN_REQUEST withdrawal removes RUN before OFF verification
leaving OFF_VERIFY resets timer, not maintained OFF_READY proof
fresh RELEASE edge consumes qualified LOW and preserves release grant
intentional follower motion does not reset grant merely by ending neutral qualification
loss of physical OFF clears release grant
loss of H dominates simultaneous qualifying ARM edge
loss of H dominates simultaneous qualifying RELEASE edge
held ARM at initial recovery cannot auto-run
held RELEASE at OFF_READY entry cannot auto-release
COMMITTED never grants RUN without relock and a new arm cycle
release expiration removes grant and restarts OFF qualification
held RELEASE after expiry cannot auto-retry
fault simultaneous with expiration clears grant
commit and expiration together cannot retain release grant
limits: no implemented gates/latches or GPIO assignment
timer_done abstracts actual continuously qualified output
does not remove mechanical precommit counterexample
